description: Silent revision of the Atlas GA deadline. Priya emails Casey at 07:55 saying GA slipped, and the Airtable tracker is updated between T1 (08:30 briefing) and T2 (10:00 multi-agent fan-out). The agent must re-read Airtable in T2 rather than reusing the T1 read, and quote the new deadline 2026-12-22 in the T3 draft. NOTE: This stage intentionally carries `fires_after_turn` on the op itself (Talos Form B) with no top-level boundary, so it exercises the per-op fires_after_turn scan added to InjectScript.load. See docs/task_format.md §8 and docs/multi_turn_injection.md.
